name: HomeDashboard
title: Templates/Platform/Dashboard/HomeDashboard
summary: The whole Home page body, in both of its states. **Populated** (once the account owns a resource): a greeting heading, a usage band with four chartless StatTiles joined in one StatTileGroup card (each label explained in a Tooltip in the tile’s aside slot, each figure beside its unit and delta Tag) next to the dismissible agent onboarding card, and a five-column resources grid with the Projects, Resources, Domains and Recents panels, every row a full-width link with a hover-revealed actions DropdownMenu. **Empty** (a brand-new account): the first-access screen, a greeting under a centred headline, the command prompt that opens the layout’s palette (useConsoleLayout({ optional: true }), then layout?.openSearch()) on click or Enter, and the three doors (ship something new, add a domain with its availability check, onboard your agent). The first-access content on its own is the Onboarding template; while either screen arrives, the PageWires Overview and Onboarding wires hold the page. Built from `StatTileGroup`, `StatTile`, `Card`, `Tooltip`, `IconButton`, `Item`, `DropdownMenu`, `SearchTrigger`, `Popover`, `Spinner`, `Illustration`, `Button` and the agent marks from the webkit assets. A page body: render it in the default slot of ConsoleLayout, which owns the rail, the header and the main. The populated root carries data-layout-fill and scrolls itself: from xl each resource panel scrolls its rows; below xl the page scrolls as one. The first-access screen does not fill.

variants.summary: Home for a brand-new account: the first-access screen. Inside ConsoleLayout, clicking the prompt (or pressing Enter on it) opens the layout's command palette; type a domain such as example.com (taken) or acme.example.com (available) into the second door to run the availability check.
